name: app-blue-voice-calls-app-with-giant-ghost-title
title: Blue softphone app held in a low-angle hand shot over a giant outlined wordmark
whatItIs: A cobalt gradient cover with 'SOFTPHONE' in giant thin outlined letters behind, a woman in a black blazer lower right and a phone held toward the camera at a low angle. The screen shows conversations with a semicircle gauge (2,835), stat numbers and a recent call row. A pill 'App Design' and app icon sit in the corners.
whatItMeans: Modern and dynamic; the low angle and giant type make a utility app feel bold.
techniques: Set an oversized outlined wordmark behind a person and device.
Use a single blue gradient throughout, including the screen.
Shoot the phone from below to add drama.
Show a gauge as the hero data element.

vocabulary.definition: Large letters drawn as thin outlines behind content.
A photo taken from below, looking up.
A dial chart used as the main data visual.
A cover in one hue with tonal gradient.
